policies.text: Entry into the high-velocity document scanner registry requires a document throughput rate of at least 100 pages per minute.

Authorization for installation in medical commercial sites is granted to a device designated as a high-performance dehumidifying system that features a commercial coverage term of no less than 2 years.
Acoustic compliance is met for equipment demonstrating a maximum operational sound level of 45 decibels.
Eligibility for regional distribution rebates requires a minimum annual order volume of 500 units.
A unit attains classification as a high-performance dehumidifying system when equipment that satisfies sound guidelines also delivers a daily moisture removal capacity of at least 50 liters.
An equipment item secures premium industrial tier endorsement when possessing a continuous operating rating above 12 hours.
